meta.og:description: Mayza Design is an Ethiopian fashion and art design brand in Addis Ababa, blending cultural dress with modern fashion.

items.en: Mayza Design is a fashion and art design brand based in Addis Ababa.
items.am: ማይዛ ዲዛይን በአዲስ አበባ የሚገኝ የፋሽን እና የጥበብ ዲዛይን ብራንድ ነው።

items.en: Rooted in culture, made for now
Our work starts from Ethiopian cultural dress, and especially from the red, black and yellow woven bands that Sidama clothing is known for.
items.am: ስራችን የሚነሳው ከኢትዮጵያ ባህላዊ አልባሳት ነው፤ በተለይም የሲዳማ ባህል ልብስ ከሚታወቅባቸው ቀይ፣ ጥቁር እና ቢጫ ጥለቶች።

items.en: We carry those colours and patterns into the way people dress today: a wedding dress, a stage outfit, a child's dress or an everyday tee.
items.am: እነዚህን ቀለሞችና ጥለቶች ዛሬ ሰዎች በሚለብሱት መንገድ እንሰራቸዋለን፤ ለሰርግ ቀሚስ፣ ለመድረክ ልብስ፣ ለልጆች ቀሚስ ወይም ለዕለት ቲሸርት።

items.en: Each piece is cut and sewn to order. We aim to offer designs and materials you will not find anywhere else.
items.am: እያንዳንዱ ልብስ በትዕዛዝ እና በልክ ይሰፋል። የትም የማያገኙትን ዲዛይንም ሆነ ማቴሪያል ለማቅረብ እንጥራለን።

items.alt: Two men at the Mayza studio, one in a white vest and trouser set

items.en: The patterns and colours carry meaning. We use them with care and get them right.
items.am: ጥለቶቹና ቀለሞቹ ትርጉም አላቸው። በጥንቃቄ እና በትክክል እንጠቀማቸዋለን።

items.en: Clothing looks its best when it fits, which is why we sew to your measurements.
items.am: ልብስ የሚያምረው ሲገጥም ነው። ለዚህም ነው በልክዎ የምንሰፋው።

items.en: Every collection is our own drawing, starting from tradition and moving somewhere new.
items.am: እያንዳንዱ ስብስብ የራሳችን ንድፍ ነው፤ ከባህል ተነስቶ ወደ አዲስ ነገር የሚሄድ።

items.en: Let us make your next outfit together.
